program.help:
Second-pass spike detection variant that runs threshold detection on the spatial-derivative + temporal first-difference signal (matching ndm_extractspikes_stderiv), then applies shadow-cluster assignment to the detected spikes in-place.
Detection thresholds are computed internally from the stderiv signal over the start..start+duration window using the Quiroga (2004) robust formula. Waveform extraction writes stderiv-transformed amplitudes so downstream PCA / feature projection sees the same signal space as ndm_extractspikes_stderiv's .spkD.N output.
Most parameters are inherited from ndm_extractspikes_stderiv: thresholdFactor, refractoryPeriod, peakSearchLength, start, duration, sdiffOrder.
The shadow-clustering stage is shared with ndm_reextractspikes — see that program's help for a description of reextractMinClusterSize, reextractChi2, reextractExtraFeat, reextractInflationRatio, reextractInflationCap, and reextractAutoSubcluster.
OUTPUT
Merges in-place into $session.{res,spk,fet,clu}.N. Originals preserved at $session.<ext>.<N>.bak on first run.
SEE ALSO
ndm_reextractspikes — raw-signal variant ndm_extractspikes_stderiv — first-pass stderiv detector ndm_subcluster_unmatched — re-cluster the unmatched bin
